verdict.rationale: Abacum's docs say budgets and live actuals sit in one model (top-down targets, bottom-up inputs, live actuals), with normalized charts of accounts. They also claim drill-down to source data and numbers that are traceable when questioned, so the core pieces of budget-vs-actuals with drill-down are claimed. However, the drill-down claim is tied to three-statement consolidation rather than variance analysis, and no explicit variance report is described. Missing for 10: explicit budget-vs-actuals variance reporting, department-level dimension slicing, drill-down from a variance to its transactions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
